summary: The prescribed recursive chain partition has exactly the stack-matching successor proved in the candidate. Changing the last three unmatched ones gives the four claimed nonterminal sources, and their spike points have arithmetic mean equal to the original Boolean word. The prefix-maximum criterion and both parity-dependent reflection counts are correct, including the smallest dimensions. The accepted convex-realization lemma applies to the newly defined spike set without any normalization change and proves the stated disjoint lattice-point decomposition. Injectivity, the cardinality bounds, the dimension-seven inequality, and the asymptotic limit then follow as written. No mathematical error or gap was found.
